Why FormflowX

Built for teams that move fast and watch spend

No per-response pricing

Typeform charges by the response. FormflowX doesn't. Collect as many responses as your plan allows — Pro is $15/month flat.

AI builder included free

Describe your form in one sentence. The AI generates questions, field types, answer options, and logic — so you're not starting from blank every time.

Integrations on free plan

Slack, Notion, and Google Sheets are free. Your team gets notified the moment a lead or feedback submission comes in — no upgrade required.

Drop-off analytics

See exactly which question causes people to abandon. Fix it. Watch completion rates climb. Most tools charge extra for this — Pro includes it.

Partial submission capture

If someone gives you their email on step 1 and drops off on step 4, you still have that lead. Invaluable for waitlists and high-intent lead forms.

3,000+ app connections

Zapier and Make connect FormflowX to HubSpot, Salesforce, Airtable, Mailchimp, and anything else in your stack — no custom code.
